english.title: Act as member of flight crew which must be carried in a non-EASA aircraft without appropriate licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) acted as a member of the flight crew which must by or under the Air Navigation Order 2016 be carried in a non-EASA aircraft registered in **(..SPECIFY NON-UK COUNTRY..), when you were not the holder of an appropriate licence granted or rendered valid under the law of the country in which the aircraft,

(A)_[flying for the purpose of commercial air transport, public transport or commercial operation, was registered or the State of the operator]_
(B)_[on a non-commercial flight, was registered under the Order, the CAA not giving a direction to the contrary]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 148 and 265(7) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
acted as a member of the flight crew which must by or under the Order be carried in a non-EASA aircraft registered in a non UK country
when you were not the holder of an appropriate licence granted or rendered valid under the law of the country in which the aircraft,
flying for the purpose of commercial air transport, public transport or commercial operation, was registered or the State of the operator OR
on a non-commercial flight, was registered under the Order, the CAA not giving a direction to the contrary

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Article 148 was amended on Exit Day to remove the reference to non-EASA aircraft and add a further exception to the offence - Following Exit Day, please see offence document H20176.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None
